rules_applied: FALSE != LIE; policy inconsistency is not deception evidence by itself.
Atomic propositions retain independent truth and knowledge states.
Speaker office and authority at statement time are evidence; adviser rhetoric is not silently promoted to binding state policy.
Houthi evidence does not propagate to Hamas.
Later narrower negotiating formulations do not erase earlier claims and do not prove abandonment of omitted conditions.
Anonymous-source reporting can establish a reported proposition while speaker authority remains unresolved.
Support, financing, weapons, training, strategic guidance, operational assistance, operation-specific direction and organization-wide command/control are distinct propositions.
